query:
SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT id) AS IDs,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE time IS NULL OR lat IS NULL OR lon IS NULL OR ve IS NULL OR vn IS NULL) AS core_null_rows,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE sst IS NULL OR isnan(sst)) AS sst_missing,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT sst_ok) AS sst_unusable,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT sst2_ok) AS sst2_unusable,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE (sst IS NULL) != (sst1 IS NULL) OR (sst IS NULL) != (sst2 IS NULL)) AS sst_missing_mask_disagreement,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE err_lat<0) AS negative_lat_uncertainty,
sum(greatest(absent_hours_before,0)) AS absent_grid_hours,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_R) AS R_rows,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_R AND NOT sst_ok) AS R_sst_unusable,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_R AND NOT sst2_ok) AS R_sst2_unusable
FROM read_parquet('data/train/*.parquet')
